cohort: The study included 89 women with a mean age of 28 years who underwent caesarean section under spinal anaesthesia.
finding: The overall prevalence of Post Dural Puncture Headache (PDPH) was 42.7% and was significantly associated with gestational age, number of attempts during spinal anaesthesia, larger needle gauges, and an increased number of CSF drops.
mod_finding: Patients who underwent emergency caesarean section had a higher risk of developing Post-Dural Puncture Headache compared to those who underwent elective caesarean section.
